paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is 5.92, with a change of -0.84% compared to the prior close and -10.03% over a window of 23 sessions. The price is as of August 21, 2026.

Recent news includes statements from Fermi CEO Lee McIntire regarding the Texas governor's data center pause and its impact on Project Matador, as well as the appointment of Lee McIntire as interim CEO. Other news includes a US subpoena related to Project Matador and construction underway at the Project Matador campus in Texas.

There have been recent SEC filings, including a Form 4 and a Form 10-Q, which reports a net loss for the second quarter of 2026. Additionally, there was a Form 8-K filing announcing the appointment of Lee McIntire as CEO, with an annualized base salary of $750,000 and eligibility for a target annual bonus of up to 100% of his base salary.
